ladder.label: TOPPING
ladder.why: Daily momentum just crossed down and price lost its 10-day average mid-cycle. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Trim or tighten stops; next likely support is the daily-cycle timing band (~day 36-42, now day 21).
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum curling up; investor cycle failed (broke its start low); investor cycle overdue; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 35 · failed · daily cycle day 21).
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Prior cycle topped early (a tiring-trend hint)

entry.text: Momentum rolled over and the 10-day average is lost — reduce or tighten stops.
entry.text_zh: 动量已掉头向下且失守 10 日均线——减仓或收紧止损。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 21 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 21 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 35 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: overdue — the bigger cycle is stretched, expect more volatility
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 35 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 逾期——更大的周期已被拉伸，预计波动加剧
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 日线动量刚刚向下交叉，且价格在周期中段失守 10 日均线。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 减仓或收紧止损；下一个可能的支撑是日线周期的时间窗口 （约第 36-42 天，现为第 21 天）。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量开始上翘；投资者周期失败（跌破起始低点）；投资者周期已逾期；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 35 周 · 已失败 · 日线周期第 21 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：做顶中。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
仍位于 10 日均线之下
日线动量刚刚向下交叉
上一周期见顶偏早（趋势走弱的暗示）
ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ TOPPING signal just triggered today (fresh cross from NEARING A LOW). Signal strength: moderate (score -50/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 做顶中信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自接近低点翻转）。 信号强度：中等（评分 -50/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：强卖出/离场形态（-71）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
